discovery_notes: Cell B081 BoxLunch 2023 (any maker). 29 standard searches, snippets only; mostly Disney Pins Blog plus BoxLunch listings and mall-hosted BoxLunch listings. Maker from listing titles (Loungefly) or blog (Uncas International); else boxlunch-only key. Mystery members recorded only for Disney100 Glitter (Hallmark '1 of 6 designs') and Haunted Mansion Icons (UK retailer names six designs); all 'features/includes' lineups held. Non-exclusive Loungefly sets sold at BoxLunch keyed without boxlunch (retailer claim added). Valentine's 2-pin packs recorded as child sets only. Marvel Infinity Saga backpack set (b096) not found at BoxLunch, so no corroboration added.
